records.title: SVCBench: A Streaming Video Counting Benchmark for Spatial-Temporal State Maintenance

records.title: Reclaiming Lost Text Layers for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: source-free cross-domain few-shot learning for vision/text layers; it is a task adaptation method, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Multi-Agent Debate with Memory Masking
records.reason: MAD-M² removes erroneous memories to improve debate robustness, but the primary text says dynamically selecting/masking memories itself consumes additional tokens or internal-state computation; it reports reasoning robustness rather than reduced inference cost. The memory-mask mechanism could affect context size, but no net resource benefit is established, so borderline for a possible follow-up on total token/quality accounting.
